review_evidence: README identifies Verso as the Lean authoring framework used for books, manuals, websites, and other Lean-authored documents; source inspection found 331 Lean files and 1,600+ declaration-shaped definitions/theorems across src/, doc/, scripts, and test-projects.

Test-projects are not disposable fixtures: anchor-examples contains Tree.flip_flip_eq_id and website/documented-package examples define typed structures such as Ty and Zipper/LawfulZipper, so path-name-only exclusion would hide formal search evidence.

doc/ and src/ contain the actual document language, elaboration, rendering, extension, and release-note interfaces; no bounded subtree was shown to be lossless under the corpus definition/interface invariant.
summary: Retain Verso authoring/runtime sources, documentation sources, and test projects because the unit contains reusable Lean interfaces and formal examples rather than a separable generated-only subtree.
